reviews.text: Celada Painting delivers on all the hallmarks of professionalism: Experience, knowledge, punctuality, and impressive attention to even the smallest details. Celada Painting brought an historic 168-year-old federal colonial back to glory through arduous work and an obvious joy of making old new again.

We were extremely happy with Steve and his helper, Hector. They did a beautiful job removing wallpaper in our living room and bathroom and then painting the walls. They did more than we expected them to do. Steve is easy going and easy to deal with, but he and Hector work quickly and efficiently for a very reasonable price.

Steve came today and repainted our bathroom.   He also spackled all the imperfections in the wall and made the room look brand new!    He was very professional, efficient and very competitively priced.   I highly recommend his work and we will be having us do more in the future!
